our_interpretation: The antecedent means material customer payment failures or persistent delinquency against agreed payment terms. Larger receivables or longer agreed terms alone do not establish it.
The ordinary financial reading of the consequence is a material adverse earnings effect from those payment problems, such as credit-loss charges or lost sales attributable to nonpayment.
'Come earnings season' means the earnings report reflecting the payment failures. Without a dated trigger, it supplies no fixed calendar deadline.
The claim does not identify an accounting basis or a particular earnings measure; these must not be silently supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Verified material customer payment failures are followed by an earnings report documenting a material adverse effect attributable to those failures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After verified material payment failures, the relevant completed reporting and collection cycle establishes that they caused no material adverse earnings effect.
